newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-TELEMACHUS BOWLS BOLAND TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TELEMACHUS BOWLS BOLAND TO VICTORY.

text.p: A career-best 6-21 from paceman Roger Telemachus propelled Boland to a 195-run victory over Griqualand West on the final day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match at Boland Bank Park on Monday.
Needing 279 to win, Griquas slumped in the face of some nagging line-and-length bowling from the South African A fast bowler and they were bowled out for only 83 in their second visit to the crease.
Telemachus received good support from Leicestershire pace bowler David Millns, who took 2-29 in 15 overs, while the left-arm spin of Claude Henderson yielded 2-19 in 10 overs.
The only Griquas batsman to show any kind of resistance was Pieter Barnard who occupied the crease for just over two hours in compiling a defiant 29.
But once Barnard was trapped leg before wicket by Henderson, his team's innings folded as they lost their last six wickets for just 35 runs.
Boland first innings 268 (Lloyd Ferreira 127; Cedric English 5-65)
Boland second innings 260 (Kenny Jackson 70, Adrian Kuiper 63)
Bowling: Telemachus 14.4-6-21-6, Millns 15-6-29-2, Williams 8-4-5-0, Henderson 10-5-19-2, Kuiper 3-1-4-0.
